title: Words that call for the imperfective

blocks.text: Often the use of the proper aspect is clearly indicated by the context. For instance, the following words and phrases require the use of an imperfective verb: I. indicating duration of an action: **долго**, **недолго**, **всё утро**, **весь день**, etc.
II. indicating habitual action: **обычно**, **всегда**, **иногда**, **часто**, **редко**, **каждый день**, **каждую неделю**, etc.

head: English
Russian
rows: 2. Present perfect progressive: I have been writing all morning.
Present, imperfective: Я пишу уже всё утро. ("уже" usually added)
3. Any progressive tense: I am writing a letter. I was writing a letter. I will be writing a letter.
Imperfective aspect: Я пишу письмо. Я писал письмо. Я буду писать письмо.

blocks.text: From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: Каждое предложение на Татоэбе уникально, потому что все повторы ___ (удаляться).
exercises.prompt: Every Tatoeba sentence is unique, because any duplicates get deleted.
exercises.why: **удаляться → удаляются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He used to meditate in the morning.
exercises.why: **медитировать → медитировал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**вести → ведут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The teacher pokes his nose into everything.
exercises.why: **совать → суёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Я ___ (оббегать) весь город в попытках занять немного денег.
exercises.prompt: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.
exercises.why: **оббегать → оббегал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.q: Я весь день ___ (сидеть) перед монитором и потому попадаю под сильное электромагнитное излучение.
exercises.prompt: I sit in front of a computer screen all day, so I get pretty heavily bombarded by electro-magnetic waves.
